title: 20 March 1964: UK single release: Can't Buy Me Love
content:
The Beatles’ sixth UK single, ‘Can’t Buy Me Love’, was released on this day. Its b-side was ‘You Can’t Do That’.

Both songs were taken from the forthcoming A Hard Day’s Night album and film, and the single’s catalogue number was Parlophone R 5114.

Page last updated: 18 March 2017
